tour.interface.name: Interface: what’s in it
tour.interface.desc: A tour of the top bar, library, 3D view, 2D surface and edit panel.
tour.interface.1.title: Top bar
tour.interface.1.text: Up top: Save, Export, undo and redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), ⓘ About (license and links) and ⚙ Settings (language, style, data and these tutorials).
tour.interface.2.title: Library
tour.interface.2.text: On the left: Import your models (STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP…), Batch (one design per key of a keyboard), Generate keycap, filters, sorting and search. The bundled Cherry MX models are never modified.
tour.interface.3.title: 3D view
tour.interface.3.text: Drag to rotate. The Iso, Top, Bottom, Front and Side buttons move the camera; you can also pick the material, compare with the original, make a horizontal cut and orient the part for printing.
tour.interface.4.title: 2D surface
tour.interface.4.text: The chosen face is shown flat with dimensions. It has a ruler, critical zones, canvas rotation and zoom, and the edit toolbar. If the model has several faces, switch them with the “Faces” tabs.
tour.interface.5.title: Edit panel
tour.interface.5.text: On the right: design layers (image, text, templates), settings of the selected layer, printability (thin strokes, wall thickness) and mesh quality.
tour.interface.6.title: Saving and mobile
tour.interface.6.text: Save into folders and export to STL, 3MF, STEP… with the approximate size of each file. On mobile, the bottom tabs switch between Library, Model, Surface and Layers.
tour.key.name: Design a key
tour.key.desc: Create a keycap from scratch with the parametric generator.
tour.key.1.title: Open the generator
tour.key.1.text: Press “Generate keycap” in the library and stay on the “Key” tab.
tour.key.2.title: Key shape
tour.key.2.text: Pick a profile (Cherry, OEM, SA, DSA, XDA, flat), row R1–R4, width and height in units (1 u = 19.05 mm), dish, radii and Cherry MX stem. The 3D view updates instantly; profiles are approximations.
tour.key.3.title: Mesh resolution
tour.key.3.text: “Mesh resolution” raises the detail up to Extreme (≈15 µm) for very fine resin printers. More resolution means heavier files.
tour.key.4.title: Inside mark
tour.key.4.text: Every key carries a relief on its inner ceiling with the icon, © NC ND and the GitHub profile, invisible once mounted. You can choose its position, mirror it for transparent material and drag the icon in the picker; it can’t be removed.
tour.key.5.title: Name and size
tour.key.5.text: Enter a name (required). You’ll see the approximate STL file size. “Generate and open” creates it in your library, ready to design.
tour.keyboard.name: Design a keyboard
tour.keyboard.desc: Create every key of a keyboard or macropad and customize them one by one.
tour.keyboard.1.title: Keyboard tab
tour.keyboard.1.text: In the generator open the “Keyboard” tab. You’ll see four numbered steps.
tour.keyboard.2.title: Step 1: the base
tour.keyboard.2.text: Pick a preset (60%, 65%, TKL, 104, numpad, ortholinear, macropad with knobs) or load a QMK info.json / KLE JSON. “Macropad 26” is 5×5 keys plus a knob.
tour.keyboard.3.title: Step 2: overall look
tour.keyboard.3.text: Profile, row assignment, legend layout (QWERTY, Dvorak, Colemak…), stem, resolution and inside mark apply to every key.
tour.keyboard.4.title: Step 3: customize each key
tour.keyboard.4.text: Click a key to edit its legend, size, position, profile or row. Drag to move, use “Add key” or “Add knob” to place a piece in a gap, or change the Type to turn a key into a knob.
tour.keyboard.5.title: Step 4: create
tour.keyboard.5.text: Enter the folder name (required) and press “Generate keyboard”: one model per distinct size and one design per key are created, with the approximate total size.
tour.designs.name: Add designs
tour.designs.desc: Put text or images as relief or engraving on a key.
tour.designs.1.title: Open a model
tour.designs.1.text: Pick a model from the library (or the key you generated). The top face is selected automatically.
tour.designs.2.title: Choose the face
tour.designs.2.text: Tap another face in the 3D view to design on it; each face keeps its own layers. The switch mounting zone (bottom) can’t be touched.
tour.designs.3.title: Insert a design
tour.designs.3.text: “Insert design” adds an image (PNG, SVG, JPG…) and “Text” adds a legend. Move, scale and rotate in the 2D view.
tour.designs.4.title: Relief or engraving
tour.designs.4.text: Choose relief or engraving, the depth and, for resin, stroke compensation and wall angle. Check “Printability”: it warns about strokes that are too thin.
tour.designs.5.title: Save and export
tour.designs.5.text: “Save” asks for a name and stores it in a folder. “Export” produces STL, 3MF, STEP, OBJ… and shows the approximate size of each format.
storage.title: Browser storage
storage.full: Browser storage is full: could not save. Export a backup or free up space (delete models or designs you don’t use).
storage.high: Browser storage is {percent}% full. Export a backup or free up space.
storage.nearlyFull: Browser storage is almost full ({percent}%): saving will soon fail. Export a backup and free up space.
storage.volatile: This browser can’t store data permanently (private mode or site data blocked?): your work will be lost when you close the tab. Leave private mode or allow site data, and download a backup.
storage.mode.server: Data is stored on the server, not in the browser.
storage.mode.persistent: Protected storage: the browser won’t delete your data even when space runs low.
storage.mode.best-effort: Regular storage: the browser may delete your data if the device runs out of space. Press “Protect my data” and export backups.
storage.mode.volatile: No permanent storage: data only lasts until the tab is closed.
storage.protected: Done: the browser will protect your data and won’t delete it when space is low.
storage.notGranted: The browser didn’t grant protection (Chrome and Edge grant it based on site usage or if you install the app; Firefox may ask permission; Safari decides on its own). Export backups.
storage.unsupported: This browser can’t request data protection. Export backups.
storage.lastBackup: Last backup: {date} ({days} days ago). Back up regularly.
storage.neverBackup: You haven’t made any backup yet. Your data only exists in this browser.
storage.webNote: This site stores everything in THIS browser and device: nothing is uploaded to a server. If you clear site data, use private mode or switch browser or device, you won’t see your models and designs: use backups.
